system.longDesc:
Capacity: 1+ Slot

You can plug your central nervous system directly into the control interface for a vehicle, including things like remote-controlled drones, driving or piloting it more efficiently than having to use manual controls. For each slot allocated to your vehicle rig, choose one of the following enhancements:

  • You gain the benefits of the Dexterity (Driving) or (Piloting) focus with the vehicle, if you don’t already have it. If you do, you gain an additional +1 bonus to tests using those focuses.
  • If you fail a Dexterity (Driving) or (Piloting) test, you can re-roll the test, but must use the second result.
  • When you generate stunt points while plugged into a vehicle, you gain +1 SP.

Game modifiers on this item: focus +1 (Dexterity (Driving) focus, +1 if chosen, off); focus +1 (Dexterity (Piloting) focus, +1 if chosen, off). Items apply their modifiers while equipped; switch the ones that are off on when they apply.
